title: Vignatelli Amleto. Communication From Italian Consular Authorities I. E. Matreieff

page_data.en:
January 12 3.

R. Rapax, Esq.,
Consular Judge for Italy,
Italian Consulate-General,
555 Bubbling Well Road.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of your
letter No.35 Pos.Tr. of January 10,1933, and to state that
the Italian subject named Vignatelli Amleto arrived from
Tientsin by rail at the Shanghai North Station at 5.54 p.m.
January 11,1933. He was met by members of the Municipal
Police and, after having spent the night in the Central
Police Station, was brought at 10 a.m. January 12 before
your Consular Court which decided to release him.

Amleto is at present staying in a Russian
boarding-house at No.17 Route des Soeurs.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(Sd) F. W. Garrard
Commissioner of Police.
page_data.zh:
1月12日 3.

R. Rapax 先生，
意大利领事法官，
意大利总领事馆，
静安寺路555号。

先生：

谨此确认收到阁下1933年1月10日第35 Pos.Tr.号来函，并告知如下：名为 Vignatelli Amleto 的意大利籍人士于1933年1月11日下午5时54分乘火车抵达上海北站。工部局警务处人员前往接站，其在中央捕房过夜后，于1月12日上午10时被带至阁下之领事法庭，法庭裁定将其释放。

Amleto 目前寄居在姐妹会路（Route des Soeurs）17号的一家俄国人经营的寄宿公寓内。

谨此致意，
先生，
您忠顺的仆人，

（签名）F. W. Garrard
警务处处长。

Form No. 2
G. 25000-1-32

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
Special Branch S. A. Station
Date January 12, 1932.

Subject (in full) Vignatelli Amleto. Communication from the Italian
Consular Authorities re.

Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Moore.

With reference to the attached communication from
the Italian Consular Authorities regarding one Vignatelli
Amleto, I have to report that I called on Judge Rapex at
11.30 a.m. January 11, when he instructed that should Amleto
be located he was to be detained by the Municipal Police and
brought before him at 10 a.m. January 12.

D.S.I. Moore and C.D.S's 48 and 96 (S.2), accom-
panied by a representative of the 5th Division Chapei Police
Station, went to the North Railway Station at 5.15 p.m. Janu-
ary 11. to await the arrival of the Tientsin-Pukow-Hanking
Express which arrived at 5.54 p.m. Amleto was observed lea-
ving the train and was apprehended by the undersigned and
taken to Central Police Station, where the circumstances of
his apprehension were explained to him. He was detained at
Central Station overnight and taken before Judge Rapex at
10 a.m. January 12.

After questioning Amleto for an hour the Judge
wrote the following decision on the Charge Sheet "After in-
terrogating Amleto, Vignatelli I am of the opinion that he
is looking for work and is a bona-fide traveller . He does
not appear to be connected with political activities."

Amleto left the Consulate together with a Russian
named I.E. Matreieff who accompanied him from Tientsin. Both
are miners and their intentions are to proceed to French Indo-
China, with a view to obtaining work.

They are staying in a Russian Boarding House, No.17,
Route de Souers.

D. S. I.
Officer i/c Special Branch.
12.1.33.

表格编号 2
G. 25000-1-32

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
特别分支 S. A. 分站
日期 1932年1月12日。

事由（全称）Vignatelli Amleto。关于意大利领事当局的来函。

由 D.S.I. Moore 撰写并转发。

关于所附意大利领事当局就一名名为 Vignatelli Amleto 之人发出的信函，本人须报告如下：本人于1月11日上午11时30分拜访了 Rapex 法官，当时他指示，若找到 Amleto，应由工部局警务处予以拘留，并于1月12日上午10时将其带至法官面前。

D.S.I. Moore 及刑事侦缉股警员第48号和第96号（S.2），在闸北第五分区捕房一名代表的陪同下，于1月11日下午5时15分前往北站，等候从天津经浦口至汉口的特快列车，该列车于下午5时54分抵达。观察到 Amleto 下车，由下述签署人将其逮捕并带往中央捕房，向其解释了逮捕情形。他在中央捕房被拘留过夜，并于1月12日上午10时被带至 Rapex 法官面前。

在对 Amleto 进行了一小时的讯问后，法官在控罪书上写下如下裁决：“经讯问 Vignatelli Amleto 后，我认为他是在寻找工作，且为正当旅客。他似乎与政治活动无关。”

Amleto 与一名名为 I.E. Matreieff 的俄国人一同离开领事馆，此人从天津起便陪同他。两人均为矿工，其意图是前往法属印度支那，以期获得工作。

他们现住在姐妹会路（Route de Souers）17号的一家俄国人寄宿公寓内。

D. S. I.
特别分支主管警官。
1933年1月12日。

ACKNOWLEDGED
11 / 1 / 1933
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
B. REGISTRY

No.35.-
Pos. Tr.

CONSOLATO GENERALE D'ITALIA
SHANGHAI

Shanghai, January 10th. 1933.-

URGENT    The Commissioner of Police
          Shanghai

Sir,

    Following a telegram from the Italian Consul in Tientsin, I have the honour to inform you that an Italian citizen, named Vignatelli Amleto, born in Bertinoro (Forlì -Italy), aged 42, bearing a passport issued by the Italian Consulate of Seattle (U.S.A.), left Tientsin on the evening of yesterday (January, 9th) at 9.30 p.m. for Pukow, bound for Shanghai. He is due to Shanghai to-morrow (January, 11th.) in the afternoon.

    The Italian Consul in Tientsin, having reasons to doubt the activities of the said man, who pretends to come to Shanghai for the purpose of marching to Indochina, has expressed the advisability of watching his steps, during his stay in Shanghai. He is middle sized, wearing spectacles, leather riding boots long jacket and round astrakan cap. He has graysh beard and travels in third class.

    I have therefore the honour to request your kind assistance in this matter, in order to have the said man duly watched since his arrival, and in case anything suspicious arises, to have him arrested and brought to this Consulate General.

    At any rate, even if nothing suspicious be seen in him, I would ask you to have the said man accompanied before me on Thursday morning ( the 12th.instant) at 10 o'clock for the necessary investigations.

    Thanking you in anticipation, I have the honour to be,

                                Sir,
                            Your obedient servant

                        Consul Judge for Italy in China.
（印：CONSOLATO GENERALE D'ITALIA SHANGHAI）

1933年1月11日
上海公共租界工部局警务处
B. 登记处

第35号.-
Pos. Tr.

意大利驻上海总领事馆
SHANGHAI

上海，1933年1月10日.-

急件    致警务处处长
        上海

先生：

    接意大利驻天津领事发来的电报，谨此通知阁下，一名名为 Vignatelli Amleto 的意大利公民，出生于意大利弗利省的贝尔蒂诺罗（Bertinoro, Forlì -Italy），现年42岁，持有意大利驻西雅图（美国）领事馆签发的护照，于昨晚（1月9日）晚上9时30分离开天津前往浦口，目的地为上海。他预计将于明天（1月11日）下午抵达上海。

    意大利驻天津领事有理由怀疑该男子的活动，该男子声称来上海的目的是为了前往印度支那，因此表示建议在其逗留上海期间监视其行踪。他中等身材，戴眼镜，穿皮马靴、长夹克和圆形阿斯特拉罕羔皮帽。留有灰白胡须，乘坐三等车厢旅行。

    因此，谨此请求阁下在此事上给予协助，以便在该男子抵达后对其进行适当监视，若出现任何可疑情况，则将其逮捕并带至本总领事馆。

    无论如何，即使未发现其有可疑之处，本人亦请阁下安排于本周四上午（即本月12日）10时将该男子带至本人面前，以便进行必要的调查。

    预先致谢，谨此致意，

                                先生，
                            您忠顺的仆人

                        意大利驻华领事法官。
（印章：意大利驻上海总领事馆 CONSOLATO GENERALE D'ITALIA SHANGHAI）
